description:
One marketplace listing in full: its metrics, the signals it is built from (names only; the creator's tuning is never exposed), its backtest summary, and whether it is already in this account. Use it before describing or offering a specific listing, so what you say is what the marketplace holds.

[Access: pay 0.001 USDC via x402 (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header) OR authenticate with an API key. An x402-capable client will auto-pay; API-key clients pay nothing per call.]
name: get_marketplace_strategy
